# Dell parser fixtures

These HTML files are **synthetic test cases**, not copies of Dell's live pages. The
reference URL and `aa18250_reg_01` SKU came from the user. Price, configuration,
markup, and stock fields were invented solely to exercise parser branches and must
not be interpreted as real Dell offers.

The development host received HTTP 403 for the reference URL on 2026-09-21.
Real page behavior remains unverified and requires an opt-in TrueNAS-side test.
